描述_EN: when wound up, the mouse moves along quickly on its four feet, causing the upper part of the toy to sway. the clockwork mechanism is housed inside the bottom half of the body. this toy is unusual in that the mouse's body is composed of two parts connected by a loosely coiled wire. this toy was made in china for the local market rather than for export.
描述_ZN: 当上弦时，老鼠用它的四只脚快速移动，导致玩具的上半部分摇晃。 发条机制被安置在身体的下半部分。 这个玩具是不寻常的，因为老鼠的身体是由两部分组成的，由一根松散的盘绕的电线连接。 这个玩具是在中国为本地市场制造的，而不是为了出口。
